title: MongoDB Cloud - Delays in Atlas cluster management operations
text:
Service: MongoDB Cloud
Incident: Delays in Atlas cluster management operations
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2026-09-30T18:51:35.414Z
Resolved: 2026-09-30T21:02:02.492Z
Updates:
- 2026-09-30T21:02:02.492Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-09-30T19:26:13.657Z: monitoring - The team has implemented a fix and latency of Atlas Cluster management operations are returning to normal. Clusters that incorrectly appeared as degraded in the Atlas UI are also beginning to correctly update their status.
- 2026-09-30T19:01:35.809Z: identified - We've identified an issue with metric ingestion that is causing delays to Atlas Cluster management operations for some customers. Clusters may also appear degraded in the Atlas UI while metrics ingestion is delayed; however, the cluster health is unaffected.
- 2026-09-30T18:51:35.478Z: investigating - We are investigating an issue with Atlas metrics ingestion that may delay cluster management operations, including cluster creation and modification.

incident.name: Delays in Atlas cluster management operations

incident_updates.body: The team has implemented a fix and latency of Atlas Cluster management operations are returning to normal. Clusters that incorrectly appeared as degraded in the Atlas UI are also beginning to correctly update their status.

We've identified an issue with metric ingestion that is causing delays to Atlas Cluster management operations for some customers. Clusters may also appear degraded in the Atlas UI while metrics ingestion is delayed; however, the cluster health is unaffected.
We are investigating an issue with Atlas metrics ingestion that may delay cluster management operations, including cluster creation and modification.

components.name: MongoDB Cloud
components.description: This includes MongoDB Cloud Manager and MongoDB Atlas
